tasks.title: Implement transparent minimal/full tool call and result display modes
tasks.rationale: Tool calls currently hide exact model-supplied arguments for extension tools and compact tool results consume too much vertical space. Implement the approved design in the Pi core TUI.

acceptanceCriteria: Tool calls support minimal and full display modes, with minimal as the default.
Minimal tool calls expose actual model-supplied top-level argument names and values in at most one visual terminal row, with visible truncation or omission markers.
Tool results support minimal, compact, and full modes, with minimal as the default and inline with the call when possible.
Minimal tool execution rendering bypasses the current mandatory spacer and vertical box padding.
Compact and full modes preserve existing specialized renderers and backward compatibility for expanded:boolean and setToolsExpanded(boolean).
Call and result modes are independently configurable and controllable through configurable keybindings.
Session JSONL, model-visible context, and ToolOutputPolicy semantics remain unchanged.
Focused rendering tests and npm run check pass; runtime-impact changes are documented.

tasks.title: Reproduce and localize orphan function_call_output after Claude-to-Codex model switch
tasks.description: Reproduce the verified persisted-session incident where a healthy claude-bridge assistant toolCall and matching aborted/error toolResult were present in raw Pi history, but the subsequent OpenAI Codex request was rejected with `No tool call found for function call output with call_id toolu_01PLWRr5aidacJz7F8PQzYzg.` The clean four-message `convertResponsesMessages` path preserves the pair, so diagnosis must reconstruct the actual effective request pipeline and delta-debug the surrounding session state before selecting a fix layer. Determine whether loss occurs in SessionManager/buildSessionContext, extension context hooks, transformMessages, OpenAI Responses conversion, Codex request continuation/state, or remote validation. Do not patch around the symptom before the first divergent representation is proven.

No live paid-provider request is required. Any optional real-provider confirmation is separately bounded and explicitly authorized by Patrik before execution.

tasks.title: Enforce atomic tool-call/result spans across transformed provider history
tasks.description: After T002 identifies the responsible boundary, harden Pi's canonical/cross-provider message transformation so a provider request never contains a tool/function result without its matching call and never contains duplicate synthetic plus real results for the same call. Preserve genuine error tool results, exact call/result identity, chronology, and provider-specific replay constraints. Prefer a single canonical coherent-span invariant over provider-specific symptom repair.

requiredReferences.reason: Current second-pass skip/synthetic-result logic and tool ID transformation owner.
OpenAI Responses pairing contract and request item conversion.

sourceRefs.reason: Verified cross-provider incident and repeated orphan function_call_output failures.

acceptanceCriteria: Every emitted toolResult/function_call_output has exactly one earlier matching toolCall/function_call under the target provider's identity rules, or the whole unsafe span/request is refused before network mutation with a typed actionable error.
Skipping an error/aborted assistant cannot leave its tool results in output; preserving a real result cannot drop its call.
A user interruption that triggers a synthetic `No result provided` cannot later produce duplicate synthetic and real results for the same call ID; deterministic precedence is documented and tested.
Foreign provider tool-call IDs remain pair-preserving after normalization, including IDs with and without OpenAI Responses item-id suffixes.
Genuine error results such as `Command aborted` remain error results and are not rewritten into successful or fabricated content.
Tests cover assistant error/aborted with toolCall, real result before/after user boundary, duplicate result, missing call, multiple parallel calls, model switch, and the exact T002 regression.
Foreign-thinking handling is not silently changed as a side effect; any policy change to textification/exclusion requires a separate accepted decision.

The implementation is developed in the correct dedicated pg/core or pg/ext worktree chosen from T002 evidence, passes targeted packages/ai tests and npm run check, and updates the applicable changelog/docs.
